summary: Proposition3.2 has the opposite characteristic velocity to its own gradient-flow definition; Lemma2.2 reverses the optimal coupling arguments in its first-order limit. Complete one-dimensional examples satisfy the hypotheses and contradict both printed formulas. Corrections are verified at the declared scope; no failure of the central local convergence theorem established.

problems.statement: Prop3.2 sets V=(0,+G[mu_t]) and claims its forward flow X_t pushes mu_0 to any gradient flow mu_t, although Definition3.2 uses v=-G.
problems.hypotheses: d=p=1,Omega=R,phi(omega,x)=omega is C-infinity and satisfies Assumptions1-3; compact dataset delta_(0,0), smooth nonnegative half-square loss; all measures ds tensor delta_a have finite second moment.
counterexample: Let a(t)=exp(-t), mu_t=ds tensor delta_(a(t)). NODE x(s)=s a(t), adjoint p(s)=a(t), G(s,omega)=a(t). The actual velocity a'(t)=-a(t) gives the required continuity equation.
The positive field in(18) sends initial weight1 to2-exp(-t). Thus X_t#mu_0 differs from mu_t for every t>0, with COT distance2(1-exp(-t)). At t=log2 the distance is1.
Changing V to(0,-G) gives X_t(s,omega)=(s,omega-1+exp(-t)), mapping initial weight1 toexp(-t), and restores the characteristic representation under the same regularity.
counterevidence: The minus sign is explicit in Definition3.2, not an OCR ambiguity; actual images19/20 inspected.

Theorem3.1 Part2 p28 explicitly recovers v=-G. Norm estimates and energy decay in the convergence mechanism use descent. The p28 prose calling +G the tangent is another sign inconsistency, not a different convention.
AppendixA cites Prop3.2, but support and uniqueness estimates use absolute values/norms and survive the negative field; this finding alone does not refute those results.
problems.impact: False auxiliary characteristic identity as printed. No counterexample to Theorem4.2 local convergence established; Minor severity for bounded demonstrated impact, not for brevity of correction.
problems.correction_verification: Exact representation proved for example; general negative-field representation follows from matching the actual continuity equation under the proposition's stated regularity. Not a reconstruction of every external transport theorem.
problems.repair_status: Exact representation proved for example; general negative-field representation follows from matching the actual continuity equation under the proposition's stated regularity. Not a reconstruction of every external transport theorem.

problems.location: Lemma2.2 pp15-17; coupling marginal convention p9
problems.statement: The coupling is declared in Pi_o(mu_(t+h),mu_t), while the displayed velocity pushforward uses (first position,(second-first)/h) and claims limit+v_t.
problems.hypotheses: I=(0,1),Omega=R,mu_t=ds tensor delta_t; COT distance|t-u|,locally absolutely continuous, unique minimal tangent v_t=1.
counterexample: Unique declared coupling is ds tensor delta_(t+h,t). Its displayed pushforward is ds tensor delta_(t+h,-1).
The target is ds tensor delta_(t,+1). Their W2 distance is sqrt(h^2+4), which tends to2 and not0, for every interior t.
Reverse the coupling arguments to Pi_o(mu_t,mu_(t+h)) with the same pushforward: the result is exactly ds tensor delta_(t,+1). Alternatively keep the stated coupling but use (pi1,pi3,(pi2-pi3)/h).
counterevidence: Actual p15 image confirms order; p9 fixes first marginal as first argument.
Proof p16 states the first marginal is mu_t and uses phi(omega')-phi(omega), which matches the corrected ordering.

The lemma's second approximation statement is exact for this translation example and is the version used in subsequent differentiations. No false chain rule or failure of main convergence follows from the first display alone.
problems.impact: False local first-order limit as printed; corrected ordering directly resolves the example and matches the proof's convention. Minor; not a central theorem counterexample.
problems.correction_verification: Exact counterexample and corrected translation limit. General proof requires the standard minimal tangent argument as adapted in source; no claim to reprove the full external AGS result.
